identification.evidence_type: first-hand owner reports, not a manufacturer guarantee for every Pi case batch

mechanical_drawing.note: Page family title says 30x30x7; the actual mechanical drawing specifies 7.5 +/-0.5 thickness. Older catalogues and OEM variants may differ.

electrical_specification.note: Reuse the original Pi 4-wire fan. Generic CC3007 catalogue electrical and bearing options are not automatically identical to the Pi OEM fan.

design_decision.note: The plate moves 1mm rearward; maximum-depth fan bottom remains at z=38mm, preserving the previous heatsink clearance.
